description: Two-phase naming engine. Call without candidates to receive generation instructions for YOUR model (you generate the names). Call again with candidates[] to get anti-slop scoring, ranking, and live availability checks (domains, socials, npm). Modes: brief (describe it), auto (I analyze the current workspace), from_name (find domains/variants for a name), from_domain (fit a found domain to a project).

name.description: Existing name or found domain (from_name / from_domain).

project_path.description: auto mode: project dir for a light server-side scan (package.json name/description + top-level directory names, best-effort, no throw on missing/unreadable path).

targets.description: Availability-check targets: {tlds:[...], platforms:[...]}. Empty = pure naming, no availability checks.

name: name_project
